delegations.label: Assemble the ND teaser shot-list
delegations.detail: Rank the 24 overnight concepts from Higgsfield batch #1284 against the NDP26 brief, queue motion passes for the top three and hand Farah the shortlist

steps.args: refs=top 3 of batch #1284 · style=NDP26 brand kit

delegations.result: Shortlist of 3 ('Dawn over the Bay' leading) with motion passes sent to Farah at 09:48 — 42 minutes ahead of the 10:30 concept review

delegations.label: Chase the Wunderfolk invoice
delegations.detail: Run down the kickoff invoice on the S$126,500 EPL launch-films SOW, check it against the MSA rate card and file it for finance before the 14:30 war room
delegations.result: Kickoff invoice for S$63,250 landed by 13:55, reconciled to the MSA rate card and filed 35 minutes before the EPL war room

delegations.label: Compile the channel performance pack
delegations.detail: Pull August reach and engagement from Salesforce, refresh the five-channel brief and stage the draft in Grace's inbox ahead of the 16:30 sign-off
delegations.result: Brief showing 38.6M reach (+15% on July) and the EPL 96% flag staged for Grace by 15:40 — read before the hero-film sign-off

week.insight: Friday stacks five National Day meetings around the 16:30 sign-off for two hours of focus — push concept reviews async into Monday during campaign weeks.
